messages:
alex.levine: Hey team — customer acme-inc says Private VPC metrics disappeared from Console sometime yesterday. Charts for request count/latency show 'No data' but their API is returning 200s. Noticed this after the authz change. Anyone seen this? cc @maria.k

maria.k: which pipeline is missing? are server logs showing tenant id on requests?

alex.levine: I pulled a sample from their gateway. curl to our proxy shows header present:
```
> curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Redwood-Tenant: acme' https://private-gw.acme/api/generate
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
...\n```
But our telemetry table query returns a lot of rows with tenant_id = NULL for the same time window.

jordan: quick check — did we recently enable stricter header stripping in the ingress filter? I remember a change to remove any custom headers for external callers.

ingress-bot: deploy: ingress-filter-update v2.1.7 rolled at 2026-02-14T03:12:00Z — change: "strip_custom_request_headers: true"; rollout by sam-infra.

sam-infra: confirming — we rolled a policy to drop unapproved headers on ingress to prevent header injection. It looks like X-Redwood-Tenant wasn't added to the allowlist. That would cause the header to be stripped before telemetry tagging.

alex.levine: that matches what the customer sees. Their backend logs show tenant header, our analytics pipeline sees nothing. Any immediate mitigation?

maria.k: short-term: allowlist the header through the ingress filter for requests from that VPC. Long-term: we should fall back to extracting tenant from the JWT sub/claims if header missing.

jordan: snippet from the filter config that caused it:```
http_filters:
  - name: envoy.filters.http.header_sanitizer
    typed_config:
      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_sanitizer.v3.Config
      strip_custom_request_headers: true
      allowed_request_headers:
        - authorization
        - x-request-id
        - content-type
```

sam-infra: I patched the allowlist in staging and verified metrics flow resumed. Patch command I used (staging):
```
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap ingress-filter --type merge -p '{"data":{"allowed_request_headers":"authorization,x-request-id,content-type,x-redwood-tenant"}}'
```

alex.levine: can you patch prod? we'll need an incident window if any side-effects. Customer is seeing gaps in billing dashboards.

sam-infra: will coordinate with infra on a quick patch — target ETA 30m. Monitoring will validate metrics ingestion for acme tenant.

support-bot: Created support ticket SUP-3456 and attached initial diagnostics + links to console graphs.

eng-runtime: important note — rely-on-header is brittle. I'll open an engineering issue to add robust fallback: if X-Redwood-Tenant missing, use validated JWT claims (sub / tenant claim) and tag telemetry before storage. Will add a migration plan so we don't accidentally double-tag. Assigning ENG-6123.

maria.k: also verify that proxy-to-ingress internal requests (health checks, internal tools) don't get the header stripped — some internal paths rely on header passthrough for routing.

alex.levine: reproduction steps for the team to validate:
1) Send request with X-Redwood-Tenant from outside the VPC and confirm it reaches backend (curl above).
2) Check ingest logs: grep for tenant tag in telemetry stream (example): `grpc://telemetry -> tag:tenant=acme`
3) If missing, look at ingress filter logs: `kubectl -n ingress logs <ingress-pod> | grep strip_custom_request_headers`

jordan: after prod patch, I validated a quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.events WHERE tenant_id = 'acme' AND ts > now() - interval '15m'` — numbers started flowing ~2m after the patch.

sam-infra: prod patch rolled at 2026-02-14T03:55:10Z. Monitoring shows metrics resumed and billing charts backfilled for the 4hr gap. We'll monitor for 24h.

alex.levine: thanks. action items: (1) sam to keep patch live and monitor; (2) eng-runtime to implement JWT fallback (ENG-6123); (3) maria to update runbook with allowlist process; (4) support to notify customer and update SUP-3456.

support-bot: SUP-3456 updated with mitigation and ETA for engineering fix.

alex.levine: leaving this thread open until ENG-6123 has a PR. :thumbsup:
